title: Long Distance — Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage diaspora family love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The long distance call used to cost by the minute and we knew it
Every word we chose was chosen carefully — we grew into it
My mother's voice across the line from Zimbabwe to Perth
Was timed to fit inside the affordable bracket of its worth

[Chorus]
Long distance, long distance
The telephone line across the Indian Ocean night
Long distance, long distance
We talked in code for love because the price was tight
Long distance knows what can be said in thirty seconds flat
Long distance knows that voice itself is where the home is at

[Verse 2]
Now the call is free and the connection instant and the screen
Shows the face and still there's something in between
The distance that a voice once crossed to reach you in the dark
Is still a kind of miracle — it still contains the spark

[Bridge]
My father called on Sundays — every Sunday without fail
Before the internet, before the email trail
The sound of him across the Indian Ocean wire
Was more than just connection — it was the family fire

[Outro]
Long distance knows… the voice is everything… the line still holds…
The gardens still growing
